_readme: Map -> map-type lookup, used to bucket each game the way the 'Hera S-tier dominance' analysis video does: closed (defended start), semi-open (wallable, no defenses), open (hard to wall), chaotic (close spawns / early map-control fight), hybrid (land+water), water, nomad (no starting TC). This is NOT sourced from Liquipedia (they only tag Land/Water/Hybrid) - it's hand-curated and only covers maps I'm confident about. Maps not listed here come through the pipeline as mapType: null and get printed by the script so you can add them - you know the current tournament map pools far better than I do, so please correct/extend freely.
